offline.message: You are offline. Emot-ID is using cached content on this device.

routeLoading.title: Opening this space
routeLoading.body: Your choices stay on this device while this part of Emot-ID gets ready.
routeLoading.errorBody: The saved app files may be unavailable. Try again or return to the previous screen.

analyze.aiPrompt: I feel {emotions}. What does this emotion mean and how can I understand it better?
analyze.aiPromptMultiple: I feel a combination of {emotions}. How do these emotions relate and what might this mean?
analyze.aiDisclosure: Opens Google AI Mode with a fixed question containing only the selected emotion names.
analyze.aiWarning: This will search for general information online. Results are not a substitute for professional support.
analyze.externalAIDisabled: Google AI Mode links are off. You can enable them in Settings.

crisis.tier1: One or more selected words can accompany difficult experiences. If this feels overwhelming, support is available.
crisis.tier2: Several selected words can accompany intense distress. Emot-ID cannot determine how severe your situation is. You can reach out for support now.
crisis.tier3: These selected words can sometimes appear during severe distress. Emot-ID cannot determine whether you are in danger. Support is available now.
crisis.tier4: These selected words can accompany severe distress, but they do not tell Emot-ID whether you are in danger or having thoughts of self-harm. If either is true, or you are unsure, seek support now.
crisis.disclaimer: If you are in immediate danger, please call emergency services.
crisis.groundingBody: If you want to try it, name 5 things you see, 4 you can touch, 3 you hear, 2 you smell, and 1 you taste. Stop if it does not feel helpful.

onboarding.screen1Title: This is an exploration, not a test
onboarding.screen1Body: There are no right or wrong answers. Emotions are complex and layered. Take your time — this is a space for curiosity, not judgment.
onboarding.screen2Body: A feeling can have more than one meaning. Notice what fits your experience and leave the rest.

granularity.title: Notice the difference
granularity.lede: Choose a word or choose not sure. Each answer opens a short distinction.
granularity.notSure: I'm not sure — they all fit
granularity.feedbackSelected: You chose {emotion}. If that feels closest to your experience, your choice is valid.
granularity.feedbackNotSure: It's okay not to be sure. Emotional nuance develops with practice.

distinctions.intensity: These options can differ mostly by intensity, from mild to strong.
distinctions.duration: These options can differ by duration and by how deeply the feeling settles in.
distinctions.focus: These options can differ by focus: inner values, social image, or a wish to repair.
distinctions.time: These options can differ by time orientation: present interest, active exploration, or future readiness.

granularity.completedBody: You just practiced noticing subtle differences between similar emotions.
granularity.completedEncouragement: You can return whenever comparing words feels useful.
granularity.errorBody: Practice sets are unavailable right now. Please try again later.

chainAnalysis.title: Unpack a moment
chainAnalysis.prompt: Start with what happened. Add only the details that feel useful.
chainAnalysis.noticedPlaceholder: Feelings, thoughts, body sensations, or urges.
chainAnalysis.responsePlaceholder: Include any action, pause, or choice.
chainAnalysis.outcome: What followed, or what might help next?
chainAnalysis.outcomePlaceholder: What changed, or what could support you now?
chainAnalysis.confirmBody: Only reflections created in Unpack a moment will be removed. Your saved emotion reflections will stay. This cannot be undone.
chainAnalysis.clearError: The journal exercises could not be deleted. Your saved emotion reflections were not changed.
chainAnalysis.saved: This reflection is now in your journal.
chainAnalysis.saveError: This reflection could not be saved on this device.

dimensional.instructions: Place the feeling by its energy and how pleasant or unpleasant it feels
dimensional.keyboardInstructions: Use the arrow keys to adjust energy and how pleasant or unpleasant the feeling is.
dimensional.placeHint: Tap anywhere to place the feeling

navigation.offline: Offline. Everything here still works on this device.

today.title: How are you feeling?
today.lede: Choose the closest feeling below, or explore it in more detail.
today.quickPrompt: One of these may be close enough for now.
today.recentEmpty: Your reflections can stay here when you choose to save them.

arrival.title: What feels easiest to notice?
arrival.lede: You can change routes at any time. A rough starting point is enough.
arrival.wordsHint: Move from a broad feeling toward something more precise.
arrival.bodyHint: Notice a region, sensation, and intensity before naming it.
arrival.affectHint: Use energy and pleasantness when words are not available.
arrival.unsureHint: Begin with one simple choice and see what becomes clearer.
arrival.guideBodyTitle: Can you point to where you feel something in your body?
arrival.guideBodyHint: A general area is enough. You do not need to know what it means yet.
arrival.guideBodyYes: Yes, I can point to an area
arrival.guideBodyYesHint: Start with the location and describe the sensation.
arrival.guideBodyNotClearHint: Try placing the feeling without naming it.
arrival.guidePlacementTitle: Can you roughly place the feeling?
arrival.guidePlacementHint: Think about energy and pleasantness. No emotion word is needed.
arrival.guidePlacementYesHint: Use the map to choose an approximate position.
arrival.guideWordsHint: Start with a general feeling and narrow it down.

bodyCompass.title: Where do you notice a body sensation?
bodyCompass.lede: A sensation can offer clues, but it does not prove any one emotion.
bodyCompass.regionHint: Choose one area. You can add more after describing it.
bodyCompass.sensationHint: Choose the closest description for your {region}.
bodyCompass.intensityHint: Use the closest estimate. Precision is not required.
bodyCompass.evidenceNote: Possible words come from broad group patterns and curated hypotheses. They cannot identify a cause, diagnosis, or what you feel.
bodyCompass.notNow: I do not notice anything right now

affectMap.title: Place the feeling
affectMap.lede: Tap where your current energy and pleasantness seem closest. Approximate is useful.

wordLadder.title: Move toward a closer word
wordLadder.lede: Start broad. You may stop at any level when a word feels close enough.
wordLadder.pathHint: Any word in this path can be your answer.
wordLadder.stopHere: This word can be your answer
wordLadder.moreSpecific: Or choose a more specific word below.
wordLadder.compareHint: Choose one word from the same level. The descriptions may help; neither word has to fit.
wordLadder.compareNote: Notice which description, if either, feels closer.

plutchik.title: Combine two feelings
plutchik.lede: Choose two starting emotions from this model. The relationship is a possibility, not a diagnosis.
plutchik.instructions: Choose the two emotions that feel closest.
plutchik.fieldLabel: Eight starting emotions from the Plutchik model, arranged as a wheel

reflectionScreen.title: What seems to fit?
reflectionScreen.briefSynthesis: may be close. Keep only what fits your experience.
reflectionScreen.needPrompt: What might help most right now?
reflectionScreen.needHint: Keep the suggestion that fits best, or leave this open.
reflectionScreen.exploreHint: Choose only what feels useful. Everything here is optional.
reflectionScreen.partlyHint: Keep only what feels useful. You can revise your selection or continue treating these as possibilities.
reflectionScreen.mismatchBody: That is useful information. You can revise this path, or finish without keeping a label, need, or suggested step.
reflectionScreen.baseSaving: Saving your reflection on this device…
reflectionScreen.baseSaved: Reflection saved. Everything below is optional.
reflectionScreen.baseSaveError: Your latest selection has not been saved yet.
reflectionScreen.baseNotSaved: Saving is off. This reflection will not be kept.
reflectionScreen.detailSaveErrorTitle: The latest details were not saved
reflectionScreen.saveErrorBody: The local save did not finish. Nothing was sent online. You can try again or continue without saving.
reflectionScreen.detailSaveErrorBody: Your reflection is already in the journal. The optional details did not update, and nothing was sent online. You can try again or finish without them.
reflectionScreen.nextStepChoicePrompt: Choose an option only if it feels safe and useful in your situation.
reflectionScreen.stepPause: Pause and notice what feels manageable next.
reflectionScreen.stepWrite: Write down one observation without trying to solve it.
reflectionScreen.stepConnect: Contact someone you trust, if that would feel supportive.

exploreScreen.title: Different ways to understand a feeling
exploreScreen.lede: Each method notices something different. None is the master view.
exploreScreen.affect: Place a feeling on the map
exploreScreen.bodyHint: Start with where a sensation appears.
exploreScreen.affectHint: Place a state before trying to name it.
exploreScreen.wordsHint: Move from broad language to a closer word.
exploreScreen.plutchikHint: Choose two emotions and see a possible blend.
exploreScreen.practiceHint: Compare nearby words through short examples.

journalScreen.title: Your emotional thread
journalScreen.lede: Saved entries and simple summaries stay on this device. They offer context, not conclusions about you.
journalScreen.emptyBody: When saving is on, completed reflections will appear here.
journalScreen.earlyBody: Each reflection can stand on its own. Summaries appear only after enough relevant entries.
journalScreen.errorTitle: Saved reflections could not be loaded
journalScreen.errorBody: Your local data was not changed. Close and reopen the app to try again.

sessionDetail.title: Saved reflection
sessionDetail.older: This reflection was saved before these details were available.
sessionDetail.confirmBody: Only this saved reflection will be removed from this device. This cannot be undone.
sessionDetail.deleteError: This reflection could not be deleted. Your other entries were not changed.

privacyData.title: Privacy & data
privacyData.lede: Saved reflections stay on this device. Emot-ID has no account, analytics, or cloud sync.
privacyData.savingHint: Stored only on this device. You can change this later in Settings.
privacyData.externalHint: Opening one of these links sends the selected emotion names to Google Search.
privacyData.confirmClear: This removes saved reflections, journal exercises, and preferences from this device. It cannot be undone.
privacyData.clearSuccess: Local data was deleted and preferences were reset.
privacyData.dataError: The action could not be completed. Reopen the app and try again.

supportScreen.title: Support
supportScreen.lede: Emot-ID supports self-reflection. It is not therapy, diagnosis, or emergency care.
supportScreen.urgent: If you may be in immediate danger, call local emergency services now.
supportScreen.romania: Romania — DepreHUB: 0374 456 420, free, confidential, and available 24/7

history.valenceNote: These are counts of saved words, not your overall mood.
